entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:1
segments: Give ear, O heavens, and I will speak; and hear, O earth, the words of my mouth.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:2
segments: My doctrine shall drop as the rain; my speech shall drop down as the dew, as the small rain on the tender plant, and as the showers on the grass;

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:3
segments: because I will proclaim the name of the LORD, ascribe greatness to our God.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:4
segments: [He is] the Rock; His work [is] perfect. For all His ways [are] just, a God of faithfulness, and without evil; just and upright is He.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:5
segments: They have corrupted themselves: [they are] not His sons; [it is] their blemish; [they are] a crooked and perverse generation.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:6
segments: Do you thus give back to the LORD, Oh foolish and unwise people? [Is] He not your Father who bought you? [Has] He [not] made you and established you?

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:7
segments: Remember the days of old; consider the years of many generations. Ask your father, and he will show you; your elders, and they will tell you.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:8
segments: When the Most High divided to the nations their inheritance, when He separated the sons of Adam, He set the bounds of the people according to the number of the sons of Israel.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:9
segments: For the LORD's portion [is] His people. Jacob [is] the lot of His inheritance.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:10
segments: He found him in a desert land, and in the deserted, howling wilderness. He led him about, He cared for him, He kept him as the pupil of His eye.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:11
segments: As an eagle stirs up her nest, flutters over her young, spreads abroad her wings, takes them and bears them on her wing,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:12
segments: the LORD alone led him, and [there was] no strange god with him.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:13
segments: He made him ride on the high places of the earth, so that he might eat the increase of the fields. And He made him suck honey out of the rock, and oil out of the flinty rock,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:14
segments: butter from cows, and milk from sheep, with fat of lambs, and rams of the sons of Bashan, and goats, with the fat of kidneys of wheat. And you drank the blood of the grape.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:15
segments: But Jeshurun grew fat and kicked. You grew fat, thick, [and] satisfied. Then he forsook God who made him, and lightly esteemed the Rock of his salvation.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:16
segments: They provoked Him to jealousy with strange [gods]; with abominations they provoked Him to anger.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:17
segments: They sacrificed to devils, not to God; to gods whom they knew not, to new ones newly come up, whom your fathers did not fear.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:18
segments: You forgot the Rock [who] brought you forth, and ceased to care for God who formed you.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:19
segments: And the LORD saw, and despised [them] because of the provoking of His sons and of His daughters.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:20
segments: And He said, I will hide My face from them; I will see what their end [shall be]. For they [are] a very perverse generation, sons in whom [is] no faithfulness.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:21
segments: They have moved Me to jealousy with a no-god. They have provoked Me to anger with their vanities. And I will move them to jealousy with a no-people. I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:22
segments: For a fire is kindled in My anger, and shall burn to the lowest hell, and shall consume the earth with its increase, and set on fire the foundations of the mountains.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:23
segments: I will heap evils on them. I will spend My arrows on them.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:24
segments: Exhaustion by famine, and consumption by burning heat, and bitter destruction, and the teeth of beasts I will send on them, with the poison of crawling things of the dust.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:25
segments: The sword outside, and the terror inside, shall destroy both the young man and the virgin, the suckling [also] with the man of grey hairs.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:26
segments: I said I would dash them to pieces; I would make the memory of them to cease from among men,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:27
segments: were it not the provocation of an enemy I feared, lest their enemies should misconstrue; lest they should say, Our hand [is] high and the LORD has not done all this.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:28
segments: For they [are] a nation without wisdom, neither is there any understanding in them.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:29
segments: If they were wise, they would understand this; they would consider their latter end!

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:30
segments: How shall one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them and the LORD had shut them up?

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:31
segments: For their rock [is] not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves being judges.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:32
segments: For their vine [is] of the vine of Sodom, and of the fields of Gomorrah. Their grapes are grapes of gall. Their clusters [are] bitter.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:33
segments: Their wine [is] the poison of serpents, and the cruel venom of asps.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:34
segments: [Is] not this laid up in store with Me and sealed up among My treasures?

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:35
segments: Vengeance and retribution [belong] to Me. Their foot shall slide in time, for the day of their calamity [is] at hand, and the things that shall come on them make haste.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:36
segments: For the LORD will bring His people justice; and He shall have compassion on His servants, for He sees that [their] power is gone, and only the imprisoned and abandoned [remain].

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:37
segments: And He shall say, Where [are] their gods, [their] rock in whom they trusted?

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:38
segments: Who ate the fat of their sacrifices [and] drank the wine of their drink offerings? Let them rise up and help you; let it be your hiding place.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:39
segments: See now that I, I am He, and there is no god with me. I kill, and I make alive; I wound and I heal; and there is no deliverer of My hand.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:40
segments: For I lift up My hand to Heaven and say, I live forever!

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:41
segments: If I sharpen My glittering sword, and if My hand takes hold in judgment, I will give vengeance to My enemies and will reward those that hate Me.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:42
segments: I will make My arrows drunk with blood, and My sword shall devour flesh, with the blood of the slain and of the captives, from the hairy scalp of the enemy.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:43
segments: Rejoice, O, nations, [with] His people; for He will avenge the blood of His servants, and will render vengeance to His foes and will be merciful to His land, to His people.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:44
segments: And Moses came and spoke all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he and Joshua the son of Nun.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:45
segments: And Moses made an end of speaking all these words to all Israel.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:46
segments: And he said to them, Set your hearts to all the words which I testify among you today, which you shall command your sons to observe and to do, all the words of this law.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:47
segments: For it [is] not a vain thing for you, because it is your life. And by this word you shall prolong [your] days in the land where you go over Jordan, there to possess it.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:48
segments: And the LORD spoke to Moses that same day, saying,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:49
segments: Go up into Mount Abarim, [to] Mount Nebo in the land of Moab, which is opposite Jericho; and behold the land of Canaan which I am giving to the sons of Israel for a possession.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:50
segments: And die in the mountain where you go up, and be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother died in Mount Hor and was gathered to his people,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:51
segments: because you sinned against Me among the sons of Israel at the Waters of Strife in Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin, because you did not sanctify Me in the midst of the sons of Israel.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:52
segments: Yet you shall see the land before [you], but you shall not go there to the land which I [am] giving to the sons of Israel.
